name: arith_add
title: Integer addition throughput
measures: Additions and subtractions in a counted loop. ts-checked adds RuneScript's int32 store check to every assignment (the equivalent-semantics variant).
notes: RuneScript int arithmetic is checked: a result that does not fit int32 when stored throws RangeError. Plain TypeScript numbers never overflow at 2^31; ts-checked emulates the check.
